title: change_record
description: A production change to a high-tier application: what ships, against which accepted specification, and how it comes back if it must.

artifact_digest.description: What ships. Must be known to the artifact ledger; a digest the ledger does not hold is an ungated build.

rollback_target.description: The known-good digest the deploy event will name as the way back.

summary.description: What changes for the people who use it, in one paragraph.

verification.description: How it is confirmed in production: an alarm that stays OK, a synthetic check, a person's look.
